description: The pin for the vendored Shared Facts and API surface the docs build consumes (docs ADR-0003: Shared Facts come from one generated source). Both files are GENERATED by trueseal-sync (cargo run --bin gen-shared-facts / gen-api-surface) and vendored here at an exact upstream commit with sha256 digests — never edited by hand, never floated on a branch or latest tag (G8). Refresh with `bun scripts/sync-upstream-facts.ts <commit>`; verify with `--check`. The Release Conductor re-pins at release time from the release commit.
